title: compact-auth-facade-and-stream-consumer-polish
author: Priya Nambiar
body: Motivation: Reduce duplicated auth lifecycle logic across the Python/TS/Go SDKs and make streaming consumer ergonomics simpler for common patterns. This change introduces a compact AuthFacade that centralizes fallback and token refresh semantics, a lightweight RetryProfile helper shared by all SDKs, and a small consumer-friendly StreamConsumer surface that wraps common async-iterable/pullstream patterns. Goals: 1) cut cognitive load for application engineers integrating streaming and token rotation; 2) eliminate a recurring class of races observed in long-lived streams under intermittent 401s; 3) align retry semantics so hosted and dedicated deployments observe consistent behavior. What changed: - New compact AuthFacade API added to redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript, and redwood-sdk-go. It exposes a minimal credential lookup + fallback chain and a single refresh hook that SDKs call when 401s occur. The facade is intentionally tiny (3 methods) to encourage composition rather than inheritance. - Shared RetryProfile presets added (fast-fail, balanced, durable) with documented defaults and tuned backoffs for streaming vs unary calls. SDKs accept RetryProfile by name or config object. - StreamConsumer utility: a thin wrapper that normalizes chunked server streaming into an ergonomic async iterator with built-in reauth-on-401 wiring and opt-in checkpointing. - Small refactor to internal session code to let SDKs plug the AuthFacade without changing public client constructors. - Migration helpers and deprecation notices: old TokenProvider.swap_to and SessionManager.startWarmup are deprecated but remain functional with console warnings; migration guide added. Backwards compatibility: No breaking behavior for existing call sites by default. New APIs are additive; a few internal helper signatures were changed but kept private. We added deprecation warnings where required and documented explicit upgrade steps for users who want to opt into the new stream reauth behavior. Testing and rollout: All unit and integration tests updated across tri-sdk matrix. We added an integration test that simulates mid-stream 401 and validates graceful reauth and resume logic. CI initially flagged a flaky streaming test on Linux; the failure was due to a timing assumption corrected by a small sleep + event ordering fix and retry on test harness. Performance: Slight reduction in allocations for streaming hot path in Python and Go (microbenchmarks show ~6-8% CPU improvement for steady-state multi-connection throughput). Also small improvement in TypeScript memory churn under high-concurrency streaming. Docs and version bumps: docs/migration/compact-auth-facade.md and examples/streaming/reauth-example added. SDK versions bumped: python 1.9.0, typescript 2.4.1, go v1.6.0. Rollout plan: feature flagged server-side for canary customers first, then broad release after one week of warm traffic. Rollback path: revert the facade registration inside SDK constructors if unexpected regressions occur. See linked Linear tasks for rollout ownership and telemetry additions.
commits: feat(auth): introduce compact AuthFacade interface and basic fallback chain
feat(retry): add RetryProfile presets (fast-fail, balanced, durable)
feat(stream): add StreamConsumer wrapper with reauth-on-401 checkpointing
refactor(session): make session adapter pluggable for facade injection
docs: migration guide for compact auth facade and stream examples
test(integration): flaky stream 401 reauth test and harness timing fix
review_comments: Jared Lowe: Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) can we rename RetryProfile 'durable' -> 'throughput_safe' for clarity? (2) add an explicit example showing how to opt out of checkpointing in TS and PY

Priya Nambiar: Renamed durable->throughput_safe and added opt-out snippet in Python/TS examples; pushed a follow-up commit. The goal with short names was to balance discoverability and brevity; we can adjust further if you prefer more verbose labels.

Marta Ivanov: Found a small race when stream resumed immediately after refresh; suggested a mutex around the session swap and an integration test. I added the mutex and integration test in the last commit.
Chen Li: CI green on final run, approved. Left one stylistic nit on facade.ts (prefer explicit return types). I applied the change as part of the squash.
release_notes: Added a compact AuthFacade and StreamConsumer utilities across Python/TS/Go. New RetryProfile presets (fast-fail, balanced, throughput_safe). Migration guide added. SDK bumps: python 1.9.0, typescript 2.4.1, go v1.6.0. No breaking changes by default; see migration doc for opt-in behavior.
